You request rates from carriers and check them carefully for accuracy and cost. You prepare and submit customs declarations correctly and on time. You organize the entire logistics process: from loading and unloading to transport to the end client. You manage your own client portfolio and keep clients proactively informed of the progress of their shipments. What you bring: You have a solid foundation in transport or forwarding and are ready for the next step in your career. You are entrepreneurial, take initiative, and see yourself growing within the organization over time. In addition, you have: MBO+ (or HBO) level of work and thinking, preferably in logistics or transport. At least 1-2 years of experience as a forwarder. Good command of the Dutch and English languages; German is a plus. Experience with (customs) forwarding and Microsoft Office systems.
